# Blender Studio Human Base Meshes

`human-base-meshes.blend` contains web-trimmed copies of the realistic male and
female meshes from Blender Studio's Human Base Meshes bundle v1.2.0.

- Source: <https://www.blender.org/download/demo-files/>
- Direct bundle: <https://mirror.blender.org/demo/asset-bundles/human-base-meshes/human-base-meshes-bundle-v1.2.0.zip>
- Original authors: Blender Studio, Dan Ulrich, Paul Kotelevets,
  Tonatiuh de San Julián, and Julien Kaspar
- Original license: CC0 1.0 Universal

The copies in this repository retain the base topology but omit multiresolution
sculpt data and editor-only asset metadata so they remain suitable for a
real-time web export. Stormfather's clothing, materials, hair, cultural
features, and occupational props are original project work generated by
`blender/build_landmarks.py`.
